baseline_models.focus_anchor: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ قَالُوا بَلَىٰ
baseline_models.mechanism: An audible question asserts past co-presence, and the spoken reply concedes that proposition before redirecting attention to what the claimants did. The dispute is therefore not whether proximity occurred but what that proximity amounted to.

activation_trace.role: Raised voice and calling make the claim an attempted cross-group appeal.
Occurrence and presence in time supply the limited proposition that is conceded.
Uttered speech makes the answering 'yes' explicit rather than implied.

changed_reading.before: The callers dispute whether they were ever together with the addressees.
changed_reading.after: Past togetherness is admitted; its sufficiency for shared standing is what the following diagnosis overturns.

baseline_models.mechanism: The reflexive object makes the actors both operators and material: they did not merely encounter a test but subjected their own selves to an assay whose outcome is exposed by the ensuing acts.

activation_trace.role: Testing metal or a person supplies the assay applied by the subjects themselves.
The very self or thing itself supplies the substance placed under assay.

changed_reading.before: They succumbed to an externally imposed temptation.
changed_reading.after: They made their own selves the material of a proving process and generated the conditions of their failure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The coordinated verbs form a feedback loop: waiting opens an interval, doubt agitates it, heart-pictured wishes fill it, and bright but unstable deception preserves the imagined outcome until the divine affair arrives.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and watchful expectation supply the loop's temporal opening.
Agitated doubt supplies the unstable epistemic state sustained during delay.
A wish pictured by the heart supplies substitute future-content for the interval.
Deception by what shines but does not last explains how the wished future remains persuasive.
Arrival and occurrence close the interval that the loop had exploited.

changed_reading.before: Waiting, doubt, wishes, and deception are a list of separate faults.
changed_reading.after: They are a causal temporal-epistemic loop that manufactures a believable private future until public arrival ends it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier, being 'with you wherever you are' is universal and immediately paired with action under sight. This converts the focus claim of being 'with you' into evidentially thin co-presence: the conceded location or time cannot erase the self-directed actions then enumerated.

activation_trace.role: Presence in time supplies the focus claim whose force is being limited.
Presence wherever one is makes withness broad enough that it cannot by itself imply equivalence.
Intended action supplies the differentiating dimension attached to universal presence.
Seeing supplies the inspection under which actions, not mere location, remain visible.

structural_cues: 57:4 pairs 'with you wherever you are' with sight of what you do; 57:14 answers the withness claim 'yes' before listing acts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal withness, observed action, and the focus concession; I infer that co-presence is not equivalence of standing. Alternatively, 57:4 may establish divine omnipresence without defining human companionship.

changed_reading.before: Their shared presence is offered as proof of shared identity and outcome.
changed_reading.after: Shared presence is true but non-dispositive; accountable action differentiates people within the same apparent company.

context_deltas.mechanism: The explicit denial of equality between action before and after the opening gives waiting a non-recoverable cost. Broad membership and even later action may remain, yet a delayed act cannot simply reproduce the standing generated before disclosure and victory.

activation_trace.role: Waiting and watchful expectation supply the focus behavior whose cost is sharpened.
Past presence supplies the broad membership that does not guarantee equal rank.
Equality between two things supplies the comparison that the verse expressly rejects.
Opening into victory supplies the disclosure threshold across which timing changes value.
Taking something grade by grade supplies the unequal standing produced by action at different times.

structural_cues: 57:10 says those who spent and fought before the opening are not equal to those who did so afterward, while promising good to both.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies non-equality, a before/after opening threshold, grades, and focus waiting; I infer that delay crosses a morally non-fungible threshold. Alternatively, the focus waiting need not refer specifically to the spending and fighting of 57:10.

changed_reading.before: Waiting merely postpones an otherwise equivalent act of affiliation.
changed_reading.after: Waiting can permanently alter rank because action before disclosure is not exchangeable with action after it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Light moves with one group, is requested by the other, and cannot be recovered once a raised enclosure with a door sorts the two sides. The focus call can cross that enclosure acoustically while neither light nor access transfers, so communicative proximity survives after effective company has ended.

activation_trace.role: Raised voice supplies the residual connection that can travel across separation.
Past presence supplies the former company contrasted with present sorting.
Light and illumination supply a capacity moving with the believers.
Requested and sought illumination supplies the non-transferable resource lacking on the callers' side.
A high enclosing wall supplies the spatial sorting that speech alone cannot undo.
An entrance supplies the visible possibility of access without implying that access remains available.

structural_cues: 57:12 attaches moving light to the believers; 57:13 stages a request to borrow light, a return backward, and an inside/outside wall before the dialogue continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies carried light, failed seeking, wall, door, and subsequent calling; I infer that voice remains transmissible while light and passage do not. Alternatively, light may function only as reward imagery rather than as a causal capacity.

changed_reading.before: The dialogue continues among people who remain one social company.
changed_reading.after: Audibility is the last surviving form of proximity across a separation where light, passage, and outcome no longer transfer.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence gives duration a material consequence: extended time toward an endpoint is followed by loss of heart-softness. This makes focus waiting not a neutral empty interval but a process that can consolidate the self into a less responsive state.

activation_trace.role: Waiting supplies the duration whose cumulative effect is activated by context.
Length of time supplies accumulation rather than a momentary pause.
An endpoint or limit supplies the receding horizon across which delay extends.
Coarsening and loss of heart-softness supply the state produced after prolonged duration.

structural_cues: 57:16 places lengthened duration directly before hardened hearts; 57:14 places waiting before doubt and deception.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prolonged duration followed by hardening and the focus's waiting sequence; I infer a cumulative arrow from delay to reduced responsiveness. Alternatively, 57:16 may describe historical correlation rather than a general mechanism of waiting.

changed_reading.before: Waiting is one reversible decision among several faults.
changed_reading.after: Waiting is temporally productive: prolonged deferral can harden the very self that would need to respond.

context_deltas.mechanism: The plant analogy supplies deception with a full lifecycle: enhancement, eye-catching growth, drying, and debris, ending under the same root of deception. Focus wishes therefore need not be sheer inventions; they can borrow credibility from real but temporary flourishing and conceal its terminal phase.

activation_trace.role: A future pictured by the heart supplies the focus projection that the lifecycle fills out.
Shining but unstable deception supplies the focus mechanism linked to the later lifecycle.
Displaying and enhancing beauty supplies the lifecycle's persuasive surface.
Beauty in the eye supplies the observer's uptake of that surface as promising.
Yellowing and drying vegetation supply the concealed turn in the apparent growth.
The transient debris of worldly life supplies the terminal state omitted by the alluring view.
The repeated image of shining non-persistence labels the whole enjoyment-cycle as deception.

structural_cues: 57:20 moves from adornment and admired growth through drying and debris, then calls worldly enjoyment 'غرور'; 57:14 repeats غرر around الأماني.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the lifecycle, its terminal غرور label, and the focus's wishes/deception; I infer that wishes project the attractive early phase while suppressing the terminal phase. Alternatively, the plant image may characterize worldly life generally without specifying how the focus wishes worked.

changed_reading.before: The wishes deceive because they are simply unreal fantasies.
changed_reading.after: The wishes deceive by extrapolating a real attractive phase as though it were stable and by hiding its built-in collapse.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the تقدير branch of م ن ي inside أماني and places private wishing beside prior inscription; it remains anchored in الأماني, جاء أمر الله, and 57:22's written-before-creation sequence. Render only as a lexical-mechanical possibility, not as an etymological equation between wishing and divine decree.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ

activation_trace.role: Estimating a thing and carrying out its determination lets wishing resemble private future-allocation.
Fabricated wishes without reality keep that private allocation counterfeit.
Bringing and making present supplies the public manifestation that ends private projection.
Inscription that fixes a judgment or measure supplies an already-set alternative to private allocation.
Creation and bringing into being supply the later realization of what inscription precedes.

changed_reading.before: The wishes are merely pleasant fantasies interrupted by an unforeseen command.
changed_reading.after: The wishes act like counterfeit future-allocation until an already determined order is brought into public reality.

strongest_changes: The conceded 'yes' makes co-presence true but insufficient; action and timing determine whether apparent company becomes equal standing.
The light-and-wall scene turns the call into residual audibility across a separation where illumination and access no longer transfer.
Waiting, doubt, wishes, and deception become a cumulative loop, while the plant lifecycle shows how temporary flourishing can make that loop credible.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses social, temporal, epistemic, and material mechanisms into one reply: past company is conceded, self-assay and delay generate divergence, and repeated غرر conceals the endpoint until arrival makes the separation visible.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether 57:4's universal divine withness directly governs the human claim 'with you' or only provides a contrast.
Whether light should be read as an operative capacity or solely as reward imagery.
Whether the تقدير activation in أماني is productive lexical resonance or too branch-distant for downstream prose.
